name: 料金分布付きの範囲スライダー
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Lighthouse LH01-0077 料金分布付きの範囲スライダー. Input1 ORIGINAL is the exact histogram/range-slider base. Preserve every bar's count, xposition, width, spacing, height and original distribution, with the same two circular handle centers (left at range start, right near middle slightly before tallest gray bar). No fabricated data, smooth mountain, normalized heights, extra ticks or moved handles.
ONLY recolor original magenta selected bars and selected track segment to forestgreen#1F6444 (subtle gradient within selected group permitted without changing bar edges). Keep all unselected bars/track neutral lightgray. Keep two source white circular thumbs with fine neutral outlines and very soft source shadows at original sizes/positions, right thumb overlays bar bottoms. White#FFFFFF background. Original data topology outranks simplified Japanese mock, which is intentionally not supplied. Original selected interval includes blank early track then rising magenta bars; retain it exactly, not full left-filled bars.
Preserve original canvas aspect1030x260 with modest white margins. No text, prices, header, input fields, chart axes/labels, new controls, rectangular card or filled ambient panel. Flat crisp component raster; slider dragging/keyboard/range validation unverified. This is color-only editing, not a new histogram recreation.
reviewNotes: Original histogram topology visually retained: initial blank selected track, rising selected bars, asymmetrical gray tail including isolated far-right tall bar, same two thumb positions and relative sizes. Selected interval adapted to green; neutral unselected bars/white thumbs. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only; drag/keyboard/data semantics and owner approval unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
